title: CUSU DDR5 32GB (1x32GB) 5600MHz RAM US$230.10 (~A$346.73) with PayPal Delivered @ CUSU Official Store via AliExpress
body:
Deal: CUSU DDR5 32GB (1x32GB) 5600MHz RAM US$230.10 (~A$346.73) with PayPal Delivered @ CUSU Official Store via AliExpress

[Hereforthegoods] Wow, sub $400 32 gig ddr5 kit in this day and age
[RichardL] I suspect it might be a single stick of 32GB RAM (instead of 2x16GB).
They also have another option for '5600MHz 16GBx2 '
[Knightchampion] Yep, does seem like it. I've updated the title for this item.
[Erwark] Yep, great deal if you want 64 GB.
Running single channel isn't great though.
[DansDeal] Is it possible / bad idea to buy two to run 64 gb for $692?
[cdaddy] Just have to make sure your mobo is compatible with this ram
[Erwark] In this economy, I would say it should be fine.
Matched pairs are always better to guarantee stability at max speed/min timings, but even if you have to dial it back a tad that's a cracking deal.
A 32 GB kit locally is $600+
[Schrodinger] Was looking at this today to buy. But doesn't stack with the cashback since it's not affiliated.
Wish it was.
[Quarter Pounder] Found this for cheap https://www.aliexpress.com/item/1005012826306340.html
paid US $307.80 + 35% cashback @ TCB UK
Not bad for 64gb DDR5
[Knightchampion] That seller seems really dodgy. I wouldn't buy from them. Better cancel your order now if you can.
[Quarter Pounder] I've cancelled as the seller joined aprox a month ago. thanks for pointing that out.
[Optimistic Goat] Cheers!
Bought 2x16GB 6000Mhz sticks for $319.18 US ($471.73 AUD with Up Bank), with £83.87 ($159.86 AUD) appearing as pending cashback in TopCashback UK.
